item.title: A Look into NaviDial, Japan's Legacy Phone Service
RedSun: System user access on Win 11/10 and Server with the April 2026 Update
item.description:
📝 When Windows Defender realizes that a malicious file has a cloud tag, for whatever stupid and hilarious reason, the antivirus that's supposed to protect decides that it is a good idea to just rewrite the file it found again to it's original location. The PoC abuses this behaviour to overwrite system files and gain administrative privileges. I think antimalware products are supposed to remove malicious files not be sure they are there but that's just me.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/Nightmare-Eclipse/RedSun
